wearer.aft_is: +y: away from the wearer's back, toward the bag

none (keep M5 x 35, no part).why: nothing reaches the tails in any carry mode (sections 2-4)

shorter screw (cut 35 -> needed length).why: no standard length between 33.95 and 35; cutting saves 1.0 mm per screw

8 TPU push-on caps.why: covers the thread ends; can be lost

keeper grown into a closed cover (PPA-CF.why: one part, hides nuts and tails; reprint the keeper

B-01 doubler 60 x 60 (ULTRA 200X).why: protects B-01 only; B-01 is 34 mm away already

lumbar foam relief cut-out.why: the foam is on the wearer side; no tail points at it

B01-STRAIN.text: B-01 (ULTRA 200X: UHMWPE / HT-polyester face, 45 deg CrossPly, PET film) strains at most 5 % before the face yarns fail; no elongation is published (record challenge_ultra_200 has none). Used only as the bound that B-01 cannot bulge into the bottom bay as deep as the tails.
B01-STRAIN.settled_by: PT-3 strip pull on ULTRA 200X (already in the register): record the elongation at break

SPREADER-REV-C.text: The BP-06 Sandwich v2 sits on the stay crowns with its wearer face at the LOWEST crown height in its bottom band (z 112-145 on the H1-P STL): the conservative (closest-to-wearer) reading; its factored deflection is spreader_results.json chosen.w_fact_max.
SPREADER-REV-C.settled_by: first H1-P frame dry fit with the spreader clipped on: feeler gauge from a tail tip to the sheet

STACK-TOL.text: Stack and length tolerances for the protrusion band: boss 22 +/- 0.2 (print), ring 2 +/- 0.1 (sheet), DIN 934 m 4.0 -0.3, Ti mount base 3 +/- 0.05; DIN 7984 M5 x 35 length js15 +/- 0.5; end chamfer about one thread depth (0.5 mm, ISO 4753).
STACK-TOL.settled_by: BUILD_H1P hip step: measure tail protrusion with calipers on all 8 after torque

PADSEAT-ROUTE.text: The lumbar pad-seat bottom cord tie (BL-006 f1, 2 mm Dyneema) has no drawn route on H1-P; it is taken round the lower lumbar struts outboard of |x| 35 mm, not across the boss back.
PADSEAT-ROUTE.settled_by: HB-D3 pad-seat retention fit on the first H1-P frame
